name_en: Sobagome zosui — buckwheat groats simmered like rice porridge with vegetables
summary_ja: そばの実を塩ゆでして殻をむき乾燥させた「そば米」を、鶏肉やこんにゃく、野菜のだしで煮込む雑炊。米が育ちにくい祖谷地方に逃れた平家の落人が、そばを栽培したことから生まれたと伝わる。
summary_en: Buckwheat groats — boiled in salted water, hulled, and dried into what's called sobagome — are simmered with chicken, konjac, and vegetables into a porridge-like dish. Said to trace back to Heike clan survivors who took refuge in the rice-poor Iya valley and grew buckwheat there instead.
source_title: そば米雑炊／そば米汁 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Uchigae zoni — a zoni made with firm stone tofu instead of rice cake
summary_ja: いりこだしのつゆに里芋を煮て、餅の代わりに硬く水気を絞った岩豆腐を重ねてのせる祖谷地方の雑煮。豆腐が重なる様子が武士の「打ち違え」に似ることから名がついたとされる正月のごちそう。
summary_en: Taro is simmered in dried-sardine dashi, then topped not with rice cake but with firm, well-drained stone tofu stacked in layers, in this zoni from the Iya valley. Said to take its name from the way the stacked tofu resembles crossed swords, it is a New Year's dish of the mountain region.
source_title: うちがえ雑煮 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Ise ebi no misoshiru — spiny lobster simmered whole into a miso soup
summary_ja: ぶつ切りにした伊勢エビを水から煮出し、味噌を溶いて仕上げる家庭の汁物。ひげや足が取れて出荷できない「あがり」を活かした料理とされ、美波町では漁解禁の9月ごろ祭りで無料提供もされるという。
summary_en: Spiny lobster cut into pieces is simmered from cold water, then finished with miso for a home-style soup. Said to make use of agari, lobsters that have lost a leg or whisker and can't be shipped, and served free at a September festival in Minami marking the start of the fishing season.
source_title: 伊勢エビの味噌汁 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Tokushima shiromiso zoni — a New Year zoni finished with sweet white miso
summary_ja: 煮干しと昆布のだしで大根や里芋を煮て、餅やかまぼこ、青菜を加え、白味噌を溶き入れる正月の雑煮。祖谷の「うちがえ雑煮」など徳島には個性豊かな雑煮が並ぶ中、広く食べられている型だという。
summary_en: Daikon and taro are simmered in dried-sardine and kelp dashi, joined by rice cake, fish cake, and greens, then finished with dissolved white miso, for a New Year zoni. Said to be a widely eaten style among Tokushima's many distinct regional zoni, which also include the Iya valley's tofu-topped uchigae zoni.
source_title: 白味噌雑煮 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
